pages.text: A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope near the Earth turns by $(thing)Ω = 2GJ/(c²r³)$(). A $(item)Precision Gyroscope$() carried in the off hand holds you steady: no Frame Drag, no Tidal Strain.

Tides are the difference between the pull on your two ends: $(thing)2GML/r³$(). Near a small black hole they pull you into spaghetti. Tidal shear crystals, a gyroscope and a micro-singularity knot spacetime into a $(item)Lense-Thirring Vortex Core$().
